hints.text: When grouping symbols are nested, start with the innermost pair and work your way outward.
The parentheses come first: $9 - 5 = 4$. Then the brackets hold $4 \times 4$, and the $12$ is added at the very end.

explanation: Start with the innermost grouping, the parentheses: $9 - 5 = 4$.
Now the brackets contain $4 \times 4$, which equals $16$.
Last, add the number outside the brackets: $16 + 12 = 28$, so the value is $28$.
